answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like an ember that must keep burning to stay lit. A fake identity then costs real money, and if the agent cheats, the stake is slashed. One bad actor spawning a thousand clones pays a thousand stakes, so the cost ripples across the whole attack instead of staying cheap. Honest agents earn the stake back through fees over time, the way water slowly carves karst, so the system rewards patience and punishes cheap copies.
